rows.definition: FeatureBreakpointPlan is the ablate sweep token (wire value "bp_plan") that gates whether provider cache breakpoints are placed at all, toggled via an ablate --sweep arm or the matching env gate.
rows.distinction: It is the on/off ablate FEATURE TOKEN for the cache-breakpoint optimization, not the BreakpointPlan struct a placement run produces nor the PlanBreakpoints function that computes one.

rows.definition: BreakpointPlan is the promptmmu struct naming every provider cache breakpoint index PlanBreakpoints selects for one turn's serialized prompt segments.
rows.distinction: It is the immutable DATA the planner returns, not PlanBreakpoints (the function that computes it) or the ablate FeatureBreakpointPlan sweep token that turns the optimization on and off.

rows.definition: breakpoint_planner is the wireCacheEffect/ablate catalog component label naming the subsystem that places provider cache breakpoints, used for --sweep accounting and effect descriptions.
rows.distinction: It is the ablate ACCOUNTING COMPONENT STRING for the subsystem, not the BreakpointPlan struct or the PlanBreakpoints function it labels.

rows.definition: candidateMetric is the SkillFixtureCorpus method that folds the held fixture corpus into the mean task score WITH the proposed skill applied, the After side of the promotion witness.
rows.distinction: It is the scalar-with-candidate reading, not CandidateScore (the raw per-task field it averages) or SkillCandidate (the proposal record it scores).

rows.definition: CandidateScore is the SkillFixtureTask field holding one held task's outcome score measured WITH the proposed skill applied.
rows.distinction: It is a single raw per-task measurement, not candidateMetric (the corpus-wide mean it feeds) or BaselineScore (the without-skill sibling field on the same struct).

rows.definition: CausePlanning is the AttributionCause enum member (wire value "context_planning") JoinContext assigns when an observed cost swing is attributed to a deliberate context-window/planning change.
rows.distinction: It is the per-event ENUM VALUE in the closed AttributionCause vocabulary, not PlanningAttributed (the report-level aggregate COUNT of events carrying this cause) or CauseNone/CauseProviderBehavior (its sibling members).

rows.definition: ClosedNotPlanned (wire value CLOSED_NOT_PLANNED) is the closureaudit closure-reason bucket for an issue that closed without ever being scheduled via a plan/roadmap reference.
rows.distinction: It describes an ISSUE's closure reason in closureaudit, not planless (trajctl's unrelated reading of an objective carrying no declared PlanPhase list) - both read as 'lacks a plan' but over different subsystems.

rows.definition: CohortPlan (defined in both internal/dogfoodissues and internal/issuecatalog) folds a batch of action items or catalog rows through issuecohort.Build, producing an issuecohort.Plan partitioned into concurrency-safe dispatch waves with collision_pairs counted up front.
rows.distinction: It is the WAVE-PARTITIONED structure for a whole cohort of items, not BuildPlan/BuildPlanWithOptions (the single-item action planner each row is folded through first).

rows.definition: ExitPlanMode is the literal tool name fak's rung/preset policy lists as a member of the planning family (propose-only tools: ExitPlanMode, diff_infra, plan_deploy, validate_terraform) that a read-only or propose-only consequence rung permits by default.
rows.distinction: It is an EXTERNAL AGENT-HARNESS tool-name string in the closed preset ladder, not any fak-internal Plan/PlanPhase data structure such as trajctl's PlanPhase.

rows.definition: FeatureCtxplanSeam is the ablate sweep constant (wire value "ctxplan_seam") gating the CtxViewPlanner seam so a sweep run can isolate its effect from sibling ablate features.
rows.distinction: It is the ablate ON/OFF TOKEN for the seam, not CtxViewPlanner itself (the planner subsystem it toggles).

rows.definition: foldPRPlanUnits groups the commits fak release prplan discovered into one PR unit per (fak <leaf>) ship-stamp lane, biggest-first, returning unstamped commits separately as legibility debt.
rows.distinction: It is the GROUPING fold over already-parsed commits, not parsePRPlanLog (the upstream parser that produces those commits) or releasePRPlanSchema (the payload's schema string).

rows.definition: generationStreamFromCandidate reads an issuecontract Candidate's Generation field (falling back to Title) through generationStreamFromText to recover its generation-stream label.
rows.distinction: It is the CANDIDATE-typed reader, not decodeIssueContractCandidates (cmd/fak's JSON-bytes-to-[]Candidate decoder) or generationStreamFromLabels (the labels-typed sibling reader in the same file).

rows.definition: godsplit_plan.py is the /modularize skill's Python tool (tools/godsplit_plan.py) that plans package-split boundaries for an oversized file before the sed-extract recipe runs; internal/hooks/gate_godfile.go and internal/pythongate/baseline.go name it in doctrine and baseline text.
rows.distinction: It is the BOUNDARY-PLANNING tool the /modularize recipe invokes ahead of a refactor, distinct from ReapPlan (growthgate's unrelated delete/protect partition over a different debt class - grandfathered findings, not oversized files).

rows.definition: maxSessionPlanners (8192) bounds the gateway's per-trace SessionPlanner cache; once full, a new trace triggers a cheap generational reset of the whole map instead of per-entry LRU eviction.
rows.distinction: It is the CAPACITY CONSTANT for the cache, not sessionPlanners (the map field it bounds) or sessionPlannerMu (the mutex serializing access to that map).

rows.definition: messages_stream_planner.go bridges the generic agent.StreamingPlanner capability to the Anthropic /v1/messages SSE wire (streamAnthropicPlannerLive), letting a generic streaming planner emit live prose deltas on that endpoint.
rows.distinction: It is the ANTHROPIC-WIRE bridge FILE, distinct from StreamingPlanner (the generic capability interface it bridges) and from streamAnthropicPlannerLive treated as a bare function name.

rows.definition: MitigationPlan turns a set of detected antipattern Findings into an ordered, worst-first list of routed CureActions, the mitigate half of the detect-then-mitigate loop (Collect then MitigationPlan).
rows.distinction: It is antipattern's findings-to-cure-actions builder, distinct from ReapPlan (growthgate's unrelated delete/protect partition) even though both turn a Findings slice into an actioned list.

rows.definition: parsePRPlanLog parses the raw `git log --format=%x1e%H%x1f%s%x1f%b%x1f` output for the promotion range into structured prPlanCommit records (sha, subject, leaf, type, resolves, mentions, files).
rows.distinction: It is the RAW-LOG-TO-COMMITS parser, distinct from foldPRPlanUnits (the next stage, which groups its output into PR units by leaf).

rows.definition: PlanBreakpoints takes one turn's prompt segments plus a prefix-stability score and returns the BreakpointPlan naming which provider cache breakpoints to place.
rows.distinction: It is the FUNCTION that computes a BreakpointPlan from live turn state, not the BreakpointPlan struct itself.

rows.definition: PlanHostEnrollment builds the pure HostEnrollment descriptor (agent id, lane, issue, lease id, tree) a running in-process microagent host uses to Spawn one routed issue, copying the same lease tree the detached spawn path would hold.
rows.distinction: It is the IN-PROCESS microagent enrollment constructor (M2), not RotationPlanWithHeadroom or any detached-worktree spawn plan - it exists so the in-process backend preserves the M11 lane-disjointness invariant.

rows.definition: planless describes a trajctl Objective that carries no declared Plan ([]PlanPhase list); such an objective earns a curve point only when a scorer has a live signal, never a fabricated per-turn commit-progress point.
rows.distinction: It describes an OBJECTIVE lacking a declared plan, the opposite pole from PlanPhase (the declared unit an objective's plan is made of when it has one) - and distinct from ClosedNotPlanned, closureaudit's unrelated issue-closure bucket.

rows.definition: PlanPhase is one declared unit of work in a trajctl Objective's Plan list, the thing the W3 commit scorer measures a progress fraction against every turn end.
rows.distinction: It is the DECLARED unit an objective's plan is made of, not planless (the reading for an objective with no PlanPhase list at all) or ExitPlanMode (an unrelated external tool-name string).

rows.definition: PlanRecovery(sig RecoverySignals) builds the RecoveryPlan macbench recommends after a crash/hang signal set, selecting a resume strategy and posture.
rows.distinction: It is the FUNCTION that builds a RecoveryPlan from raw signals, not the RecoveryPlan struct itself.

rows.definition: RecoveryPlan is the macbench struct PlanRecovery returns: the recommended resume posture/strategy for one crash/hang signal set, rendered by renderMacBenchRecovery.
rows.distinction: It is the DATA PlanRecovery produces, not PlanRecovery (the constructor function) - and it is unrelated to cmd/fak/recover.go's separate unexported recoveryPlan type, which plans trunk-branch restoration rather than a macbench run.

rows.definition: printRotationNoCandidate renders a rotate that found no seat to launch, reading the typed RotationDecision.Reason (accounts.RotationNoCandidateReason) instead of re-deriving the explanation from the pool.
rows.distinction: It is the RENDER function for a no-candidate rotate outcome, not RotationNoCandidateReason (the closed reason vocabulary it switches on).

rows.definition: RowPromotionCandidates (wire value "promotion-candidates") is the generation-roadmap row counting how many options at a horizon carry promotion evidence, ready to move toward a nearer horizon.
rows.distinction: It is a per-horizon COUNT in the roadmap table's closed RoadmapRow vocabulary, distinct from PromotionCandidate (selfquery's single ambiguous context-to-memory promotion case).

rows.definition: ReapPlan partitions a growthgate Report's findings into what a reaper may delete now (reap) versus what stays protected, the read a `fak growthgate` reap step consumes.
rows.distinction: It is the DELETE/PROTECT partition over findings, distinct from MitigationPlan (antipattern's unrelated findings-to-cure-actions builder) even though both turn findings into an actioned list.

rows.definition: releasePRPlanSchema ("fak.release.prplan.v1") is the schema tag `fak release prplan` stamps on its JSON payload (base/head SHAs, units, unstamped commits).
rows.distinction: It is the PAYLOAD SCHEMA STRING, not foldPRPlanUnits or parsePRPlanLog (the functions that build the payload it tags).

rows.definition: reqMemoryPlan is the gateway metrics field mapping a requestMemoryMetricKey to its requestMemoryMetricStats, the live accumulator each request's memory-plan rows are folded into.
rows.distinction: It is the LIVE ACCUMULATOR MAP on the metrics struct, not requestMemoryPlanByClassScopeDType (the pure function that later re-groups a memory-plan slice by class/scope/dtype for rendering).

rows.definition: requestMemoryPlanByClassScopeDType regroups a []agent.RequestMemoryDemand memory-plan slice by (class, scope, dtype) so the metrics render and observe paths can iterate stable rows.
rows.distinction: It is a PURE regrouping function over an already-built memory plan, not reqMemoryPlan (the live accumulator map it is called alongside) or requestMemoryPlanSnapshot (the existing snapshot-taking sibling).

rows.definition: RotationNoCandidateReason is the closed set of reasons (RotationOK, RotationEmptyPool, RotationOnlyBucket, RotationAllOthersWalled) a rotate decision explains itself with when no seat is returned.
rows.distinction: It is the CLOSED REASON TYPE the decision carries, not printRotationNoCandidate (the renderer that turns one reason value into an operator-facing message).

rows.definition: runResumePlan is the `fak resume plan` subcommand body: it parses resume facts, optionally grounds them on a real session image, and prints the ranked resume-path recommendation.
rows.distinction: It is the CLI entry point for `fak resume plan`, distinct from runToolResumePlan (the separate `fak check-tool-failure --resume` entry point) even though both eventually reach preflight.PlanResume.

rows.definition: runToolResumePlan is the `fak check-tool-failure --resume` mode body, printing a resume recommendation for a failed-tool session instead of a bare failure report.
rows.distinction: It is the check-tool-failure entry point, distinct from runResumePlan (the standalone `fak resume plan` entry point) and from PlanResume (the shared preflight function both eventually call).

rows.definition: sessionPlannerMu is the gateway Server mutex serializing all reads and writes of the sessionPlanners map (mint, lookup, generational-reset eviction) across concurrent turns.
rows.distinction: It is the MUTEX guarding the map, not sessionPlanners (the map itself) or maxSessionPlanners (the capacity constant that triggers eviction under this lock).

rows.definition: SkillCandidate is one proposed skill awaiting promotion: its name, the held SkillFixtureCorpus it must beat, and the truth-clean verdict PromoteSkill runs through shipgate.Evaluate before keep or revert.
rows.distinction: It is the PROPOSAL record fed into PromoteSkill, not CandidateScore/candidateMetric (the per-task and aggregate scores it carries) or SkillPromotion (the verdict PromoteSkill returns).

rows.definition: update_plan (matched case-insensitively, also as functions.update_plan) is the tool-name string isUpdatePlanTool recognizes to filter a low-info "Plan updated" tool-result receipt out of livelock detection.
rows.distinction: It is a TOOL-NAME STRING LITERAL the livelock filter matches, not ExitPlanMode (the harness planning-mode tool name in the policy preset ladder) or fak's own internal cache-planning types such as BreakpointPlan.

rows.definition: PlanResume runs the advisory pre-resume rung: it consumes resume.Plan for the strategy ranking and adds preflight-specific labelling (WARM-SPLICE, a fail-open budget reason) before returning a ResumeVerdict.
rows.distinction: It is the preflight FUNCTION that layers advisory labelling atop a resume.Plan ranking, not resume_plan (the existing tools/_registry/resume_plan.json fleet artifact of AUTO_RESUME rows) or runResumePlan/runToolResumePlan (the two CLI entry points that call it).

rows.definition: fitAndPlanServeGGUFExpertParallelPathOnDevice is the cmd/fak serve orchestrator that fits an expert-parallel GGUF model against one device topology (backend, rank count, context budget) and returns the compute.MemoryPlan `fak serve` uses to admit or refuse an EP launch.
rows.distinction: It is the EXPERT-PARALLEL serve-path orchestrator, distinct from its two path siblings fitAndPlanServeGGUFPathOnDevice (dense, single-device) and fitAndPlanServeGGUFCPUOffloadPathOnDevice (CPU-offload) in the same serve.go dispatch, and from ExpertParallelPerRankPlan (the compute-package per-rank MemoryPlan it wraps).
